def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid_bins = bins > 0
    fill_ratio = np.clip((bins - remaining) / bins, 0, 1)
    # Avoid division by zero and ensure non-negative priorities
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    # Use inverse squared relative fill level to favor mid-range fill levels
    priorities[valid_bins] = 1 / (0.1 + (fill_ratio[valid_bins] - 0.5)**2)
    return priorities

    return priorities

    normalized_deviation = deviation / (item + 1e-8)
    sigmoidal_score = 1 / (1 + np.exp(2 * (normalized_deviation - 1)))
    # Only assign scores to valid bins (can fit the item)
    priorities[valid_mask] = sigmoidal_score[valid_mask]
    return priorities
